title: Maytronics Dolphin Cycle Completion Gap
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=maytronics:robot
| stats max(_time) as last_cycle by robot
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_cycle)/86400,1)

description: Uses Maytronics robot telemetry telemetry to monitor time since the pool robot last completed a cycle in index=personal.

detailedImplementation:
## Prerequisites

• **Splunk**: Splunk Enterprise ≥9.0 or Splunk Cloud — a single-instance home lab is fine. Create `index=personal` with 90–365 day retention (`indexes.conf`).
• **HEC token**: Settings → Data Inputs → HTTP Event Collector → New Token → index `personal`. Store the token in your connector's environment (never commit it to git).
• **Upstream product**: Personal HEC index — HTTP Event Collector token on index=personal.
• **Subcategory context**: Water, Plumbing & Utilities — typical feeds: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones .
• **Sourcetypes in this search**: `maytronics:robot`.
• **Network**: The connector host must reach both the vendor API/MQTT broker and your Splunk HEC port (8088/tcp).

## Step 1 — Configure data collection

Route **Personal HEC index** events into `index=personal` with `sourcetype=maytronics:robot`.

**Collection method:** HTTP Event Collector token on index=personal.

**Reference endpoint / path:** `POST https://<splunk>:8088/services/collector/event`.

**Suggested poll interval:** depends on upstream connector.

**Key fields to extract:** `sourcetype-specific — see search filters`.

**Typical connector stack:** Smart water meters (Flume/Flo/HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC..

**Author notes:** Ingest Maytronics robot telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.


Example HEC payload shape:

```json
{"index": "personal", "sourcetype": "maytronics:robot", "event": { ... vendor fields ... }}
```

Verify ingestion with:

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=maytronics:robot earliest=-24h | head 20
```

## Step 2 — Create the search and alert

This search implements **Maytronics Dolphin Cycle Completion Gap** over `personal` data (primarily `sourcetype=maytronics:robot`) across the full search range. It applies numeric thresholds on `days_since` (> 3) after max — tune these constants to your household baseline.

**Fields this search depends on:** `days_since`, `robot`. Confirm each is populated before scheduling alerts.

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=maytronics:robot
| stats max(_time) as last_cycle by robot
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_cycle)/86400,1)
| where days_since>3
| sort - days_since
```

## Step 3 — Validate

**(a) Compare to vendor UI:** Splunk Search → index=personal | stats count by sourcetype. Totals for the same day/week should match within connector lag (usually one poll interval).

**(b) Field presence:**

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=maytronics:robot earliest=-7d
| head 50
| table days_since, robot
```

Every column the detection uses should be non-null on recent rows.

**(c) Volume sanity:**

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=maytronics:robot earliest=-30d
| timechart span=1d count
```

Flatlines usually mean a broken token, expired OAuth refresh, or HEC URL change.

**(d) Threshold calibration:** Profile `days_since` before alerting:

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=maytronics:robot earliest=-30d
| stats perc50(days_since) AS p50 perc90(days_since) AS p90 perc99(days_since) AS p99 max(days_since) AS hi
```

## Step 4 — Operationalize

Create a companion dashboard titled `UC-25.19.21: Personal evidence` with the following panel layout:

**Panel 1 — Robot Table Of Days Since Last Cycle (the key fields):** Configure according to standard Splunk visualization patterns for this panel type.


Time picker defaults: set to last 30 days with named presets for 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, and 1y — the auditor needs all five windows without retyping. Enable scheduled PDF export for the full dashboard on the regulation's reporting cadence.

## Step 5 — Troubleshooting

**Personal HEC index — no Personal HEC index events / missing fields:** If `maytronics:robot` stops updating, re-check HEC token, index `personal`, and firewall to port 8088. Search `index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd group=http_event_collector` for rejection reasons. Confirm the Personal HEC index connector script is still running (`systemctl status` or cron log).

**Personal HEC index — NULL values in extracted fields:** The Personal HEC index JSON export shape drifted — compare a raw event (`index=personal sourcetype=maytronics:robot | head 1 | spath`) against the field names in Step 2. Re-map in the connector before changing the SPL.

**Personal HEC index — API error / auth denied (401/403):** Refresh tokens expire on most consumer APIs — re-authorize the scripted input, update `passwords.conf` / env vars, and verify the vendor developer app is not in sandbox mode.

**Personal HEC index — endpoint timeout / HTTP 429 throttling:** Back off the poll interval in the connector; Personal HEC index APIs often cap requests per 15 minutes on free tiers.

**Stale dashboard:** Confirm the saved search `dispatch.earliest_time` covers enough history for your `aggregation` buckets.
